name: MadMum Tiensestraat
description: Madmum coffee bar and brunch spot on Tiensestraat, with a dedicated coworking table. The interior feels a bit dark, and the music runs loud and bass-heavy.
atmosphereNotes: Slightly dark. Loud music. Bass heavy.
wifiNotes: Relatively slow wifi (3mbps down, 2mbps up)
foodNotes: Full food 12-2pm
seatingNotes: 8 person co-working table and three 4 person booths

name: Bar Madrid
description: Café and brunch spot near the centre, popular for working or studying. It has plenty of power outlets and a laptop-friendly setup.
atmosphereNotes: In the shade all afternoon, upbeat feel. Medium volume upbeat music
wifiNotes: Fast (400 Mbps down, 120 Mbps up)
foodNotes: Croques and lighter food
seatingNotes: Many smaller tables for 2 or 4 people throughout the room
outletNotes: Visit Leuven notes plenty of power outlets for everyone.

name: MadMum Train Station
description: Madmum takeaway in the historic Leuven station building on Martelarenplein, handy for early starts. Seating is limited, and outlets are scarce.
atmosphereNotes: Similar to Tiensestraat branch. Heavy music but less loud
seatingNotes: Limited group seating

name: MadMum Erasmushuis
description: Madmum coffee bar on the KU Leuven Letteren campus at Erasmusplein, tucked between greenery. It has one large group table.
atmosphereNotes: In the university. Heavy music but less loud
seatingNotes: 1 big group table

name: Bar Berlin
description: Relaxed café by Sint-Jacobskerk with Wi-Fi, coffee, and food options, suited to quiet work. No lighting over the big table, not ideal for winter/cloudy days.
atmosphereNotes: Quiet and relaxed. No lighting over the big table.
wifiNotes: Fast and stable (130 Mbps down, 36 Mbps up)
foodNotes: Breakfast 9–11 am, lunch 11–3 pm
seatingNotes: One large table and a few smaller ones
outletNotes: Four outlets on the big table and some on smaller tables

name: Noir Coffeebar
description: Cozy coffee bar in the Naamsestraat, serving coffee and baked desserts. People also use it to study.
atmosphereNotes: Relatively lively
foodNotes: Freshly baked desserts
seatingNotes: Smaller tables. Plus terrace seating
outletNotes: Some outlets inside, but not many

name: Blanco Coffeebar
description: Coffee bar on Leopold Vanderkelenstraat, known for coffee and cakes, with a calm, cosy feel.
atmosphereNotes: Relatively quiet and cozy
wifiNotes: Reasonably fast 100 / 20
foodNotes: Cakes
seatingNotes: 8 person table

name: Onan
description: Coffee roastery and coffee shop in the centre, with a terrace.

description: Coffee roastery and coffee shop on Diestsestraat.

description: Coffee bar serving breakfast and lunch.
foodNotes: Breakfast, lunch, small bites (per their site).

name: Thelma Store & Café
description: Concept store with an in-house café in central Leuven.

description: Café on Jan Stasstraat, near Ladeuzeplein.

description: MadMum location in the centre of Leuven.

name: Bad Habits
description: Coffee spot on Diestsestraat.

name: Pulse Hub
description: Pulse Hub has outlets for your laptop with smoothies, coffees, and matchas. They also have a Pilates studio in another room.
atmosphereNotes: Reported to be pretty quiet.

name: Danta's Coffee
description: Danta's had decent Wi-Fi and some cakes. They also have a croque monsieur and crepes on the menu.
wifiNotes: Reported to have decent Wi-Fi.
foodNotes: Cakes, croque monsieur, crepes.

name: Soigneur
description: Bike café with Wi-Fi.
wifiNotes: Reported to have Wi-Fi.

name: STUKcafé
description: Café in the STUK arts centre. Very large open space with lots of tables.

name: Fika Lab
description: There's a small laptop area at the back, the front of the cafe is not laptop-friendly.

name: Noordoever
description: 1 large table with outlets, sofa area with outlets. Lots of windows, but dark at night. No time limits, free tap water.
atmosphereNotes: Cozy, plants, and in the summer with a terrace with wifi
foodNotes: Vegan pastries, vegan buffet
drinkNotes: Coffee, tea, beer, fresh juices, lemonades
seatingNotes: Tables from 2-4p, 1 big table for 8p, 1 sofa area for 3p, separate space for group reservation
outletNotes: 1 large table with outlets, sofa area with outlets

name: Komfort
wifiNotes: 30 Mbps down
seatingNotes: All tables are 2-3 people but pretty small. There's one 6p table.

name: Hygge Leuven
description: Cafe in central Leuven with menu items and a cozy atmosphere mentioned in reviews.
atmosphereNotes: Cozy atmosphere mentioned in reviews.
seatingNotes: One large table.

name: Lapaz Cafe
description: Friendly cafe with fair prices on drinks, bites and toasts. Has a terrace and upstairs seating.
atmosphereNotes: Cozy, with a terrace and friendly people
foodNotes: Cakes, toasts, spaghetti for student-friendly prices
seatingNotes: 8-10 person seating near the window, 4 person tables, plus space upstairs
outletNotes: Only one outlet found, near the window

name: Bar Stan
description: Trendy neighbourhood bar and restaurant that welcomes laptops outside of lunch and dinner service hours. Known for seasonal food and specialty coffee.
openingHours: Mon-Fri 08:00-23:30, Sat-Sun closed (except occasional Sunday brunch)
atmosphereNotes: Lively and bustling, especially during peak hours. Good for casual working sessions outside busy times.
wifiNotes: Reliable for browsing.
foodNotes: Full menu with seasonal, local, and vegan options.
drinkNotes: MOK coffee, ONAN tea, natural wines, and craft beers.
seatingNotes: Mixed seating including an outdoor terrace.
outletNotes: Some outlets available along the walls.

name: Hal 5
description: Old railway hall transformed into a community centre and food court with various food stalls. Very relaxed, warehouse-style atmosphere.
atmosphereNotes: Vibrant, open, and informal warehouse vibe.
wifiNotes: Decent public wifi, though can be spotty in the large hall.
climateNotes: Can get chilly in winter and warm in summer due to the warehouse structure.
foodNotes: Various food stands offering pizza, middle-eastern food, and more.
drinkNotes: Central bar for coffee, beers, and soft drinks.
seatingNotes: Mostly large communal picnic tables.
outletNotes: Outlets are scarce, mostly near the walls.

name: Bibliotheek Tweebronnen
description: Main public library of Leuven. Reservable study places, free wifi, internet PCs, printing and scanning. Best for quiet laptop work in the centre.
atmosphereNotes: Strictly quiet and studious environment.
wifiNotes: Free public wifi available for library visitors.
foodNotes: No food allowed in the study areas.
seatingNotes: Individual desks and reading tables, reservable in the main library.
outletNotes: Outlets available at many of the study desks.

name: Wasbar Leuven
description: Cafe-laundromat hybrid where you can work, eat, and optionally do your laundry. The pastel-coloured interior is bright and welcoming for laptop users.
atmosphereNotes: Bright, trendy, and casual.
wifiNotes: Free and stable wifi.
foodNotes: Bagel burgers, pancakes, and salads available all day.
seatingNotes: Mix of regular dining tables and cozy corners.

name: Punto Caffè
description: Popular, straightforward coffee shop near the centre offering bagels, sweets, and beverages. Often frequented by students looking for a study spot.
atmosphereNotes: Bustling and student-friendly.
wifiNotes: Decent wifi connection.
foodNotes: Bagels, muffins, cookies, and brownies.
drinkNotes: Wide range of coffees, frappes, and smoothies.
seatingNotes: A mix of small tables and window seating.
outletNotes: Available at select spots along the walls.

name: Elisa by JAVA Coffee
description: Serene and beautifully decorated cafe by JAVA Coffee. Known for artisanal preparations, fresh coffee, and a peaceful atmosphere ideal for remote working.
atmosphereNotes: Cozy, tranquil, and aesthetically pleasing.
wifiNotes: Free wifi provided for customers.
foodNotes: Breakfast, brunch, and lunch options available.
drinkNotes: Freshly roasted JAVA coffee and artisan teas.
seatingNotes: Comfortable cafe seating.
outletNotes: A few accessible outlets for charging laptops.

name: Leo Pancakes
description: Cozy lunchroom specialising in sweet and savoury American pancakes and bagels. Good natural light and a surprisingly solid internet connection.
atmosphereNotes: Casual and bright with natural light.
wifiNotes: Great internet connection reported by remote workers.
foodNotes: Wide variety of pancakes and bagels, plenty of vegan options.
drinkNotes: Coffee, lattes with oat milk, and cold drinks.
seatingNotes: Standard cafe seating with some outdoor options.
outletNotes: A few outlets scattered around the seating area.

name: De Bib Leuven Heverlee
description: Neighbourhood public library in Heverlee with free wifi, internet PCs and a calm reading-room feel. Good for a short quiet work block when the branch is open.
openingHours: Mon 15:30-19:30, Tue closed, Wed 14:00-17:00, Thu 15:30-19:30, Fri closed, Sat 09:30-12:30, Sun closed
atmosphereNotes: Small, quiet branch-library atmosphere with limited opening windows.
wifiNotes: Free library wifi for people using their own device; internet PCs also available.
foodNotes: No food service in the library.
drinkNotes: No drink service in the library.
seatingNotes: Library seating and reading tables; better for individual work than calls.

name: De Bib Leuven Kessel-Lo
description: Neighbourhood public library in Kessel-Lo with free wifi and internet PCs. Useful for quiet laptop work outside the busy centre.
openingHours: Mon 15:30-19:30, Tue closed, Wed 14:00-17:00, Thu 15:30-19:30, Fri closed, Sat 10:00-17:00, Sun closed
atmosphereNotes: Quiet local-library setting. Limited opening windows, but calm when open.
wifiNotes: Free library wifi for people using their own device; internet PCs also available.
foodNotes: No food service in the library.
drinkNotes: No drink service in the library.
seatingNotes: Library seating and reading tables; best for individual focus work.

name: KUp University Bar
description: ONAN-run coffee bar in KU Leuven's University Hall, explicitly positioned as a place to study, work, meet and go online.
atmosphereNotes: University-hall cafe setting. More active than a library, calmer than a brunch queue.
wifiNotes: Site says you can go online; speed is not listed.
foodNotes: Light snacks such as banana bars and sweets.
drinkNotes: Coffee, chai latte, and other cafe drinks.
seatingNotes: Cafe seating suited to solo work, study, and small meetups.

name: Pentahotel Leuven Pentalounge
description: Hotel lounge, bar and reception hybrid with fast free wifi, 24/7 dining, and plenty of lounge seating. Good fallback when cafes are busy or closing early.
atmosphereNotes: Hotel-lounge feel with background chatter, arrivals, and bar traffic.
wifiNotes: Public listings describe free, fast or high-speed wifi.
foodNotes: Full dining available through the Pentalounge.
drinkNotes: Coffee, soft drinks, beer, wine, and bar drinks.
seatingNotes: Mixed lounge seating, tables, and bar-style seating.
outletNotes: Laptop-friendly listings mention ample power outlets.

name: Café Entrepot
description: Spacious eetcafe in the OPEK building with terrace views over Vaartkom, full food service, free wifi, and many power outlets. Better for daytime work than event nights.
atmosphereNotes: Average noise level, lively cultural-building setting, with events and exhibitions at times.
wifiNotes: Laptop-friendly listings mention free or high-speed wifi.
foodNotes: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts, and bar snacks.
drinkNotes: Coffee, beer, cocktails, and standard cafe drinks.
seatingNotes: Indoor cafe tables plus terrace seating; suitable for solo work or small groups.
outletNotes: Laptop-friendly listings mention numerous power outlets.

name: Novotel Leuven Centrum Gourmet Bar
description: Hotel lobby, bar, and restaurant near the station with free wifi, air conditioning, 24-hour reception, and full food service via the Gourmet Bar. Steady backup when cafes are full.
openingHours: Daily 24 hours; Gourmet Bar hours vary
atmosphereNotes: Modern hotel atmosphere with guest traffic and bar/restaurant noise.
wifiNotes: Official and hotel listings mention free wifi; speed not listed.
climateNotes: Air conditioning listed for the hotel and meeting facilities.
foodNotes: Gourmet Bar serves local and international dishes; breakfast also available.
drinkNotes: Hotel bar drinks, coffee, and soft drinks.
seatingNotes: Mixed hotel-lobby, bar, and restaurant seating.

name: Swartehond
description: Cozy bagel shop and coffee bar tucked into a quiet street in the centre. Popular with students and remote workers for a quick lunch and work session.
atmosphereNotes: Cozy, laid-back, and intimate.
wifiNotes: Good wifi for browsing and emails.
foodNotes: Known for delicious, freshly made bagels and pastries.
seatingNotes: Small tables suitable for 1-2 people.
outletNotes: A few outlets scattered along the seating area.
